title: Prime Minister wishes His Holiness Pope Leo XIV a speedy recovery and continued good health
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has expressed happiness to learn that His Holiness Pope Leo XIV’s surgery last night was successful.
The Prime Minister wished His Holiness Pope Leo XIV a full and speedy recovery, along with continued good health.
The Prime Minister wrote on X;
“Happy to learn that His Holiness Pope Leo XIV’s surgery last night was successful.
Wishing him a full and speedy recovery as well as continued good health.
@Pontifex”
